**Finding submitted: deviation (INSURANCE).**

- The Agreement does have an insurance clause (Paragraph 14, sitting in the § 7 block), so this is not a "missing" clause: it already provides workers' compensation as required by statute, CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence, professional E&O of USD 1,000,000, and certificates/evidence of insurance on Company's request.
- The fallback E&O floor (USD 1,000,000) is therefore already met verbatim.
- No cyber or privacy liability coverage appears anywhere in the document, and Contractor's personnel work at Company facilities and access Company computer systems under Paragraph 1(c) — so the clause fails the fallback on a material term.
- Redline (validated, `ok:true`, minimality passed): a single surgical insertion of "and cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least two million dollars ($2,000,000)" into the existing coverage list, leaving every other word of Paragraph 14 verbatim. No survival tail, expense language, or other non-element boilerplate was added, and the preferred-level higher figures were deliberately not volunteered.
